section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Cruise Control System
title: INSPECTION OF STOP LIGHT SWITCH CIRCUIT

content.text: D    INSPECTION OF STOP LIGHT SWITCH CIRCUIT

content.description: Flowchart for inspecting stop light switch circuit. The flowchart begins with 'Turn ignition switch on' and proceeds through multiple decision points checking stop fuse, release valve circuit, stop fuse circuit, and stop light switch circuit. Each decision point has Yes/No branches leading to either further tests or corrective actions.
labels: Disconnect computer and inspect connector on wire harness side as follows.
Is there continuity between terminal 1 and 2 with brake pedal depressed?
Is there battery voltage between terminal 9 and body ground?
Is there battery voltage between terminal 8 and body ground with brake pedal depressed?
Short circuit in wire harness between terminal 8 of computer and fuse.
Short circuit in wire harness between terminal 9 of computer and fuse.
Open circuit in wire harness between terminal 9 of computer and STOP fuse.
Open or short circuit in wire harness between terminal 8 of computer and terminal 2 of stop light switch.

items: Short circuit in wire harness between terminal 8 of computer and fuse.
Short circuit in wire harness between terminal 9 of computer and fuse.
